case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a renewal that is fair for both sides.

Our data puts the material side in perspective:

German producer prices for bearings and gears changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08).

We also have a clear view of the market level for this bearing:

We also buy Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 from another source, at EUR 4.06 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011504-10) and EUR 4.20 on 2026-09-22 (po:4500014447-10).

With that in mind, we propose the following:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.51; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.38; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.48; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

All three options offer a longer contract term for more planning security on your side. Option C keeps your preferred payment terms. We look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. However, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company, and that does not change our position. Please note that the alternative source pricing you provided pertains to a different context and does not reflect our specific product and service standards. 

We appreciate your detailed response and are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract term to enhance your planning security. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. 

Our main updated proposal is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Consequently, for a 24-month agreement with 30 days net payment, our best possible offer is a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to a longer term. We understand your view on the index data and will not press that point further. We also value your wish for good planning visibility on your side.

One aspect matters to us in this renewal, namely delivery reliability:

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we have prepared options we consider fair for both family companies:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.56; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.53; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option keeps the longer contract term you proposed, giving both sides planning security. Option C keeps your preferred shorter payment term.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed your note on delivery reliability; however, this metric does not impact our pricing structure for this agreement. That does not change our position. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot provides a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

To provide an alternative that balances your payment preferences, we can offer a 45-day payment term. For a 24-month contract with 45 days net, we propose a unit price of €4.89. Specifically, this alternative offer consists of a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.body:

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
